description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Prestigious Home:* Gorgeous 4BR Home with Great Amenities* Walking/Biking Distance to Grayton Beach Tram Stop and the Beach* Close to Large, Public Grayton Dunes Beach Access or Grayton Beach State Park* 4 Bikes Included - See all of 30A with Ease* 100 feet to Resort Style, Zero-Entry Pool with Clubhouse* Clean, Fresh White Linens, Laundered Each Turn* Walk to Hurricane Oyster Bar and Grayton Corner Café* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* The GRAYTest 30A Beach House is a 4BR, 3.5BA home that is beautifully furnished with coastal decor, complete with a gourmet kitchen featuring quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances. This home boasts vaulted ceilings and an open style floor plan perfect for entertaining! Enjoy games around the table or relax on 300sqft of well-furnished porch space! With two king master bedrooms, a queen bedroom, a bedroom with 2 twin beds, this home can sleep up to 8 guests comfortably! Chill on the shaded porch and balcony or head on down to the community pool just 100ft away. Take the bikes to enjoy the beautiful beaches of 30A and make wonderful vacation memories at The GRAYTest 30A Beach House!*The maximum occupancy is 8 for this home, no exceptions**Please note this property has motion activated security cameras: One security camera in the garage pointing at the garage area and a Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the property.*The Village at Grayton Beach is a new community of 47 coastal beach cottages accented with upscale touches, just minutes from the iconic white sand beaches of 30A. The Village is nearby Western Lake and Grayton State Park, perfect for launching paddle boards! The neighborhood features a resort style, zero-entry pool with a sun deck and pool house. Within walking distance to several local bars and eateries, this community offers all the best of 30A without all the hustle and bustle. Come experience The Village at Grayton Beach and see why you’ll be returning year after year! The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom #1: King Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom #2: King Bed Guest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, it provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here!Grayton Beach is a funky, free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. Among the curving live oaks you'll find this unique beach town dotted with with coastal dune lakes and bounded by Point Washington State Forest and Grayton State Beach Park. Explore clever artwork from local artisans and several local dining options. There is a laid back vibe here that may be explained by one of the local bumper stickers that says,"Grayton Beach: Nice Dogs, Strange People". Unusual and eclectic, this is a beach town you will not want to miss.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
